research_question: Does visual crowding strength predict alpha-band suppression across a fixture cohort of thirty participants?
falsifiability_criteria: If the predicted relation is not significant after correction at alpha 0.05, the hypothesis is falsified.
primary_endpoint: Spearman correlation between crowding strength and alpha-band suppression

null_model.description: Fourier phase randomization preserving the power spectrum, 1000 surrogates

known_leakage_risks: repeated sessions from one subject could leak identity across folds

split_strategy.method: five-fold grouped cross-validation by subject identifier

measurement_limitations: scalp recordings limit spatial specificity of alpha
claim_language: We hypothesize that crowding strength predicts alpha suppression; this is a correlational, exploratory analysis.
replication_plan: Replicate on an independent cohort before any confirmatory claim.

privacy_measures: access restricted to the study team
